column1: # Editorial sign-off for core-es. Hand-authored — the one file in content/es a
# human writes about content rather than writing content.
# The shipped pack is machine-generated and marked `review: unreviewed`. An entry
# here marks one item `reviewed` in the pack, so review is incremental: a slice
# can be signed off without waiting for all 1,027 items.
# `text` is the wording that was actually read and approved. The build compares
# it against the current text and fails if they differ, so an edit after
# sign-off cannot silently inherit it — re-read the row and update the entry.
# An id no item claims any more also fails the build, so a deleted row cannot
# Reviewing an item means checking: the Spanish is natural and correctly spelled
# and accented, the English gloss is accurate and unambiguous, the level and
# topics fit, and any register/address/region marking is right. See
# docs/tasks/dataset-expansion.md for what each of those means.
# No entries yet: the pack is unreviewed, and nothing here should say otherwise.
